name: coding
description: Small, tool-free software-engineering tasks focused on instruction following, correctness, and concise technical communication.

tasks.prompt: What is the time complexity of binary search over a sorted array of n items? Return only the Big-O expression.
A loop runs `for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++) { console.log(items[i].name); }`. Return exactly two lines: first line is the bug, second line is the fix. Do not include a code fence.
Return JSON only, with exactly these string fields: `method` must be `GET`, `path` must be `/users/{id}`, and `auth` must be `bearer`.
Explain in one sentence why a unit test should not depend on the system clock. Your answer must contain the words `deterministic` and `reliable`.
